name: Eliezer (son of Dodavahu)
title: Prophet from Mareshah
summary: Eliezer, son of Dodavahu from Mareshah, prophesied against King Jehoshaphat because he had formed a trade alliance with the wicked king Ahaziah of Israel. The ships he had built were destroyed as the prophecy stated.

keyEvents.title: Prophesies Against Jehoshaphat's Alliance
keyEvents.description: Eliezer predicted that Jehoshaphat's ships would be wrecked because he had allied himself with Ahaziah, and so it happened.
